scope: Track original EAX bits through all8 general registers on every direct caller path until fully overwritten, semantically used, returned or the next direct call. MOV copies and LEA arithmetic propagate the remaining original bits; memory stores/addresses and other observable reads would fail. Partial AL/AX writes only kill their own bits. The next direct call is an explicit volatile-register boundary, not an audited callee body. Three returns forward the whole untouched register; some other returns retain incidental upper bits after replacing AL. This does not establish a semantic scheduler result.
